patch_description: Two improvements: (1) corner-aware hexagonal seed with tighter spacing (rows 4,5,4,5,4,4 style adapted, but 26 = 5 rows of ~5-6), pushing end circles of outer rows toward corners where wall slack lets radii grow; (2) after relaxation, run a cheap stochastic hill-climb on positions (each circle tries small random moves accepted only if the LP/scaling sum of radii increases). The corner-shifting addresses the known waste at square corners, and local search recovers spacing the fixed relaxation misses. Also reduce relaxation steps so eval time stays low.
